name: Chicago Cubs
notes: Founded: MLB.com says the club had operated since 1876 (NL charter member); Forbes' team page says founded in 1871 as the Chicago White Stockings. Forbes: Ricketts paid $700M (2009), revenue/operating income 2025 season net of revenue sharing and stadium debt service, debt/value 8%. Tribune's 5% retained in 2009 may since have changed; not verified. The 2015 minority buyers (reported as Andrew Berlin and others) are not named on a page I could read (Forbes 2015 article returned 403), so no names or valuation recorded. Arctos stake size/date not stated. No social counts, legal entity, honours count or attendance found on citable pages.

ownership_summary: The Ricketts family has owned the Cubs since October 27, 2009, when its holding company took a 95% interest in the Cubs, Wrigley Field and ~25% of Comcast SportsNet in a deal valued at $845m (Tribune kept 5%). In February 2015 the family sold a minority non-voting interest in its holding company; Arctos Partners has also invested in the Cubs.
